answer_1.quote: By incrementally verbalizing internal thoughts, we achieve reasoning capability, speech-suitability, and low latency... our system produces natural, concise speech output...
answer_1.outputs: Speech-friendly verbalized responses from reasoning outputs

answer_2.quote: We report the accuracy for this evaluation... Word count (WC)... Flesch Reading Ease (FRE) score... Dependency depth (DD)... Nonvocalizable character count (NV)...

answer_3.quote: We assess the correctness of the final outputs using an LLM-as-a-judge framework.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation where Amazon Mechanical Turk annotators rate system responses...
answer_4.guideline: annotators rate system responses using a 5-point Likert scale across four criteria
